note: Work: the Labour Code (Loi n° 98-004 du 27 janvier 1998 portant Code du travail), article 166: children may not be employed in any undertaking before 14; article 66 sets 14 for apprentices too; 14 to 21 are 'young workers' with equal rights (article 167). The Code makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below 14 (my reading). Read from the Government General Secretariat's (SGG) scanned copy, its text layer OCR; later amendments (Loi 2017-05 on hiring) weren't checked for this article. Majority: the Persons and Family Code (Loi n° 2002-07, promulgated 24 August 2004) is on the SGG's site only as a scanned PDF without text; pages were read by eye at articles 371 to 498 but the pages printed 59 to 62, where the majority article would be, weren't found in the file's page order; left null. Service: no law on military service was found on the SGG's site; left null.

sources.title: SGG Bénin: Loi N° 98-004 du 27 janvier 1998 portant Code du Travail
sources.said: Article 166 : Les enfants ne peuvent être employés dans aucune entreprise avant l'âge de 14 ans.
